learning_outcomes.text: Know the latest generation technologies available in the field of mechanical engineering, as well as their applications in the design and management of industrial products and processes.
Able to evaluate the impact of latest generation technologies in the field of mechanical engineering.

syllabus_topics: Latest technologies applied to product and process management
teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts and problem-solving sessions
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment includes two exams: Exam 1 (Topics 1, 2, and 3) worth 50%, and Exam 2 (Topics 4 and 5) worth 50%. To pass, students must achieve an average grade of 5 or higher, with a minimum grade of 3 in each exam. If continuous assessment is not passed, students will take an ordinary resit exam covering all material, where previous partial exam scores are not carried over. If the ordinary resit is not passed, students will take an extraordinary resit exam covering all material.
